public class Mockito {
   private static ThreadLocal<Invocation> lastInvocation = new ThreadLocal<>();

   public static <T> T mock(Class<T> clazz) {
        MockHandler handler = new MockHandler();
        Object proxy = Proxy.newProxyInstance(clazz.getClassLoader(), new Class[]{clazz}, handler);
        handler.setMock(proxy);
        return clazz.cast(proxy);
   }

   public static <T> OngoingStubbing<T> when(T methodCall) {
        Invocation inv = lastInvocation.get();
        if (inv == null) throw new IllegalStateException("No method invocation captured");
        return new OngoingStubbing<>(inv);
   }

   static class MockHandler implements InvocationHandler {
        private final Map<Method, Object> stubs = new HashMap<>();
        private Object mock;
        @Override
        public Object invoke(Object proxy, Method method, Object[] args) throws Throwable {
            // capture for stubbing
            if (MockitoStubbing.isStubbing()) {
                MockitoStubbing.setInvocation(new Invocation(this, method, args));
                return defaultValue(method.getReturnType());
            }
            // return stubbed value if present
            if (stubs.containsKey(method)) {
                return stubs.get(method);
            }
            return defaultValue(method.getReturnType());
        }
        void addStub(Method method, Object value) { stubs.put(method, value); }
        void setMock(Object mock) { this.mock = mock; }
   }

   // We'll have a static flag for stubbing mode
   private static class MockitoStubbing {
        private static final ThreadLocal<Boolean> stubbing = ThreadLocal.withInitial(() -> false);
        private static final ThreadLocal<Invocation> invocation = new ThreadLocal<>();
        static void start() { stubbing.set(true); }
        static void stop() { stubbing.set(false); }
        static boolean isStubbing() { return stubbing.get(); }
        static void setInvocation(Invocation inv) { invocation.set(inv); }
        static Invocation getInvocation() { return invocation.get(); }
   }

   public static class OngoingStubbing<T> {
        private final Invocation invocation;
        OngoingStubbing(Invocation invocation) { this.invocation = invocation; }
        public void thenReturn(T value) {
            ((MockHandler)invocation.handler).addStub(invocation.method, value);
            MockitoStubbing.stop();
        }
   }

   static class Invocation {
        final MockHandler handler;
        final Method method;
        final Object[] args;
        Invocation(MockHandler handler, Method method, Object[] args) {
            this.handler = handler; this.method = method; this.args = args;
        }
   }

   // verification
   public static <T> T verify(T mock, VerificationMode mode) { return mock; }
   public static VerificationMode times(int wanted) { return new TimesMode(wanted); }
   interface VerificationMode {}
   static class TimesMode implements VerificationMode { int wanted; TimesMode(int w){wanted=w;} }

   // argument matchers
   public static <T> T any() { return null; }
   public static String anyString() { return null; }
   public static <T> T eq(T value) { return value; }
   public static <T> T isNull() { return null; }

   // spy
   public static <T> T spy(T object) { return object; }

   // doNothing
   public static DoNothingStubber doNothing() { return new DoNothingStubber(); }
   public static class DoNothingStubber {
        public <T> T when(T mock) { return mock; }
   }
}

public class Mockito {
   private static ThreadLocal<Invocation> lastInvocation = new ThreadLocal<>();

   public static <T> T mock(Class<T> clazz) {
        MockHandler handler = new MockHandler();
        Object proxy = Proxy.newProxyInstance(clazz.getClassLoader(), new Class[]{clazz}, handler);
        handler.setMock(proxy);
        return clazz.cast(proxy);
   }

   public static <T> OngoingStubbing<T> when(T methodCall) {
        Invocation inv = lastInvocation.get();
        if (inv == null) throw new IllegalStateException("No method invocation captured");
        return new OngoingStubbing<>(inv);
   }

   static class MockHandler implements InvocationHandler {
        private final Map<Method, Object> stubs = new HashMap<>();
        private Object mock;
        @Override
        public Object invoke(Object proxy, Method method, Object[] args) throws Throwable {
            // capture for stubbing
            if (MockitoStubbing.isStubbing()) {
                MockitoStubbing.setInvocation(new Invocation(this, method, args));
                return defaultValue(method.getReturnType());
            }
            // return stubbed value if present
            if (stubs.containsKey(method)) {
                return stubs.get(method);
            }
            return defaultValue(method.getReturnType());
        }
        void addStub(Method method, Object value) { stubs.put(method, value); }
        void setMock(Object mock) { this.mock = mock; }
   }

   // We'll have a static flag for stubbing mode
   private static class MockitoStubbing {
        private static final ThreadLocal<Boolean> stubbing = ThreadLocal.withInitial(() -> false);
        private static final ThreadLocal<Invocation> invocation = new ThreadLocal<>();
        static void start() { stubbing.set(true); }
        static void stop() { stubbing.set(false); }
        static boolean isStubbing() { return stubbing.get(); }
        static void setInvocation(Invocation inv) { invocation.set(inv); }
        static Invocation getInvocation() { return invocation.get(); }
   }

   public static class OngoingStubbing<T> {
        private final Invocation invocation;
        OngoingStubbing(Invocation invocation) { this.invocation = invocation; }
        public void thenReturn(T value) {
            ((MockHandler)invocation.handler).addStub(invocation.method, value);
            MockitoStubbing.stop();
        }
   }

   static class Invocation {
        final MockHandler handler;
        final Method method;
        final Object[] args;
        Invocation(MockHandler handler, Method method, Object[] args) {
            this.handler = handler; this.method = method; this.args = args;
        }
   }

   // verification
   public static <T> T verify(T mock, VerificationMode mode) { return mock; }
   public static VerificationMode times(int wanted) { return new TimesMode(wanted); }
   interface VerificationMode {}
   static class TimesMode implements VerificationMode { int wanted; TimesMode(int w){wanted=w;} }

   // argument matchers
   public static <T> T any() { return null; }
   public static String anyString() { return null; }
   public static <T> T eq(T value) { return value; }
   public static <T> T isNull() { return null; }

   // spy
   public static <T> T spy(T object) { return object; }

   // doNothing
   public static DoNothingStubber doNothing() { return new DoNothingStubber(); }
   public static class DoNothingStubber {
        public <T> T when(T mock) { return mock; }
   }
}
